verdict.rationale: A no-training or data-use policy is a fair question for a SaaS tool gateway that relays user requests and data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no statement, setting or policy on whether user data is used to train AI models. Self-hosting is a user-side arrangement, not a documented no-training guarantee, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
